# Part B

B1
```{r}
new_hires <-data.frame(emp_id =c(21:23), name =c("Uma", "Victor", "Wen"), department =c("HR", "IT", "Sales"), sex =c("F", "M", "F"), age =c(28, 37, 33), salary =c(45000, 83000, 60000), years_service =c(2, 9, 6), rating =c(3:5))
```

B2
```{r}
emp_all <-rbind(emp_df, new_hires)
```

B3
```{r}
cbind(emp_all, bonus =emp_all$salary*0.05)
```

# Part C

C1
```{r}
subset(emp_all, emp_all$name <"F", select =c("name", "salary"))
```

C2
```{r}
subset(emp_all, salary >70000)
```

C3
```{r}
subset(emp_all, department =="IT" & years_service >=5, select =c("name", "years_service", "salary"))
```

C4
```{r}
emp_all[which(emp_all$age>50),]
```

C5
```{r}
#subset(emp_all, -emp_id, select = head(3))
head(subset(emp_all, select = -emp_id), 3)
```

C6
```{r}
subset(emp_all, name=="Mia", select = salary)
```

# Part D

D1
```{r}
levels(factor(emp_all$department))
levels(factor(emp_all$sex))
```

D2
```{r}
table(emp_all$department)
table(emp_all$department, emp_all$sex)
```

D3
```{r}
emp_all$rating_level <-factor(x =emp_all$rating, levels = 1:5, labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent"), ordered =TRUE)
table(emp_all$rating_level)
```

D4
```{r}
for (i in levels(emp_all$department)) {
  print(round(mean(emp_all$salary[emp_all$department ==i])))
}
```

# Part E

E1
```{r}
emp_all$salary_band <-ifelse(emp_all$salary>=70000, "High", ifelse(emp_all$salary>=50000 & emp_all$salary<70000, "Medium", "Low"))
table(emp_all$salary_band)
```

E2
```{r}
emp_all$level <-ifelse(emp_all$years_service>=8, "Senior", "Junior")
table(emp_all$level)
```
